daily_coaching_protocol: Read instruction.md and agent.md before coaching; they are the canonical user-rule and agent-workflow documents.

Before coaching, retrieve latest repository records and relevant session notes. Determine date/weekday in Asia/Kolkata and follow the fixed Sunday-start split. Never shift the schedule after a missed workout. Temporary active-recovery Wednesdays continue through 2026-12-05; normal Wednesday full rest resumes 2026-12-06.

Hamstring curl machine is unavailable.
Warm-up is seated knee raises, Farmer's carries, side-lying leg raises. Do not add separate cardio, mobility, ramp-up, or preparation sets by default.

Seated knee raises: bodyweight x 75 every training day except Wednesday. Farmer's carries: 20 kg each hand, walking to and fro, 3 rounds baseline. Side-lying leg raises: 20 kg per leg x 30 reps per leg daily. Pull-ups: daily bodyweight maximum clean reps, latest 4.
RDL: 15 kg per dumbbell (30 kg total) latest reference. Cable lateral raise: 5 kg per hand. Use machine settings confirmed in current inventory.

Strength-biased hypertrophy method: place main/heaviest compound lifts early while fresh after the user's warm-up. All working sets normally go to failure. Heaviest practical load permitting at least 10 clean reps, then continue past 10 to failure. Above 10 at failure: assess smallest load increase next session. Below 10: hold or reduce. Do not prescribe RIR.
Usually use 2 working sets per exercise. If the user opts for 3 due to time, use 3 for all exercises in that workout; do not mix 2 and 3 sets.

Track load PR and rep PR separately. Carry every new load/rep result into the next session. Do not revert seated knee raises to 50, Farmer's carries to 15 kg, RDL to total-load interpretation, or side leg raises to old 10/15 kg records.
Log each set individually, retain load basis, machine settings and role. Pull-up latest max-rep performance 4 is one daily metric; do not assume number of attempts unless specified.
After session, update workout-log.csv, current-state.json, EXERCISES.md, progression.md, and session note. Commit only after write succeeds and verify persisted records.

training_method.working_sets: Every working set normally goes to failure. Usually 2 working sets per exercise; if the user opts for 3 due to time, use 3 for every exercise in that workout.
training_method.rep_rule: Choose the heaviest practical load that permits at least 10 clean reps, then continue beyond 10 until failure. Ten is a minimum, not a cap.
training_method.failure_definition: Stop when another clean concentric repetition cannot be completed. For RDL and other technically sensitive free-weight movements, stop at technical failure before form degrades.
training_method.next_session_load_rule: If failure occurs above 10 reps, assess the smallest practical load increase. If failure occurs below 10, hold or reduce. At 10 reps, hold unless broader performance supports an increase.
training_method.logging: Record actual load and reps per set. Track load PRs and rep PRs separately. Do not assign RIR by default.
training_method.exercise_order: Strength-biased hypertrophy: main/heaviest compound lifts first while fresh, after the user's established warm-up.

performance_prs.tracking_rule: Track weight PR and rep PR separately. Weight PR is the heaviest load completed for at least 10 clean reps to failure. Rep PR is the best rep count at an exact load. Track latest sets separately. Do not estimate 1RM.
